notes: Held at 2100 Liberty Heights Avenue, Baltimore. The page also mentions a summer job part. Ask about the summer and spring sessions. We could not read all of the Branches page. It did not confirm a work permit, in-person sessions or a family orientation, so ask the program. The foundation phone is (410) 448-5663 and the email is info@parksandpeople.org.
name: Branches Paid Internship
what_you_do: After-school paid internship with outdoor conservation work, weekly college and career sessions, and money and teamwork skills, with a focus on green careers.
who_can_apply: Baltimore City high-schoolers, per the program page.
pay_detail: Paid. The rate is not stated on the page.
duration: A fall session, Monday to Thursday 4:30 to 6:30 pm (the 2025 session ran Sep 30 to Dec 18)
deadline_text: The page says applications for the Branches Fall 2026 session are open now. No closing date is shown. The session dates on the FAQ are from 2025.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Branches Fall 2026 application on the Parks & People page. Contact Sophie Poirier, sophie.poirier@parksandpeople.org, 410-448-5663 x108.
